Una herramienta first-party de Anthropic puede estandarizar cómo los equipos pequeños escriben evals, afectando estimación y secuenciamiento (definir evals primero como criterio de alcance).

critic.argument: The claim rests on a single document from an RSS feed with zero engagement, so there is no independent corroboration—coverage is n, not a pattern. The 'first-party from Anthropic so it probably matters' line is the author's speculation about influence, not a demonstrated finding; predicted relevance is being laundered into existence.
